, आंध्र प्र िेि राज्य के जिला-श्रीकाकुलम में जिर्िवष्ट भूजमका अजधग्रहण करिे के अपिे इरािे की घोषणा करती है। और, उक्त अजधसूचिा का सार िैजिक स्ट्र् ािीय समाचार पत्रों अर्ावत् तेलुगु में "आंध्र ज् योजत " काजितहु आर्ा। और िबदक सक्षम प्र ाजधकारी द्व ारा दकसी व्य जक्त से कोई आपजत्त प्र ाप्त िहीं की गई है। और , सक्षम प्र ाजधकारी िे उक्त अजधजियम की धारा 20ई की उपधारा (1) के अिुसरण में अपिी ररपोटव केंद्र CAO/CON/RSP/VSKP/20E/ROB-447] एच. अिंतरामि, चीफ इंिीजियर(जिमावण -II) -- 6 of 12 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(i)] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 7 MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS [East Coast Railway (Constitution)] NOTIFICATION Bhubaneswar, the 8th May, 2026 NOTICE UNDER SECTION 20E OF THE RAILWAY ACT, 1989 S.O. 2340(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (East Coast Railway, Construction Organisation), Notification number, S.O.13(E). dated 2nd January, 2026 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part-II, section-3 Sub-section (ii), dated 2nd January, 2026 (herein after referred to as the said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) (herein after referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely, “Construction of Road Over Bridge in lieu of closing of manned LC No ML-447 at Km 786/3-5 between Sigdam - Cheepurupalli on Main Line of Waltair Division” in the Vizianagaram district state of Andhra Pradesh. And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily local newspapers namely "ANDHRA JYOTI" in Telugu (Visakhapatnam Edition) on dated 05th February, 2026 and “NEW INDIAN EXPRESS” in English (Visakhapatnam Edition) dated 05th February, 2026 under sub- section (4) of section 20A of the said Act and whereas no objection has been received from any person by the competent authority. And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its report to the Central Government. Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the schedule annexed here to shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that on publication of the notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed here to shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances. -- 7 of 12 -- 8 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] SCHEDULE Brief description of the land to be acquired, with or without structures, falling within the Special Railway Project, namely “Construction of Road Over Bridge in lieu of closing of manned LC No ML-447 at Km 786/3-5 between Sigdam - Cheepurupalli on Main Line of Waltair Division” in the Vizianagaram district state of Andhra Pradesh.
